— Our Story —

A Small Classroom That Grew With Its Students

Bright Future Academy began in Sargodha with a single room, a whiteboard and twelve students whose parents wanted better than crowded tuition centres. Word travelled the way it always does — through results.

Today we run school classes from Class 6 to Matric, a full Coding School track, and skill courses in SEO, Digital Marketing and English — still with the same rule we started with: no child is just a roll number here.

Coding School FAQ

Questions About the Coding Track

Do I need my own laptop?

No — the academy computer lab is open for every Coding School session, and all practice work is done there. A laptop at home helps, but it is not required to join.

I have never touched coding. Can I still join?

Yes — Module 1 assumes zero experience. Most of our graduates started exactly there; the track is paced for complete beginners.

What will I have at the end of 24 weeks?

A live capstone website built for a real client, a portfolio page, a completion certificate, and the confidence to present your work on Demo Night.

Are the timings suitable with school?

Yes — Coding School runs in evening batches (4–6 PM) designed around school hours, with the mentor hour on Friday and workshops on Saturday.

Can I pay the course fee in parts?

Yes, the Coding School fee can be paid in two instalments. Speak to the office or message us on WhatsApp and we will arrange it.

Will this help me earn?

Graduates leave with a portfolio and client-ready skills in websites and SEO. Many take their first freelance or local-business clients within weeks of Demo Night — we guide you through that first step.

— Questions —

Frequently Asked Questions

What documents do I need for admission?

A copy of the student's B-Form or CNIC, the last result card, and two passport-size photographs. For skill courses, a CNIC copy is enough.

Is there a free trial class?

Yes — every new student can attend one free trial class before confirming admission, so the family decides with full confidence.

How do parents follow progress?

Weekly test marks are shared on WhatsApp, and a full progress report is given every month. Parents can meet teachers any Saturday.

Can a student join in the middle of the session?

Yes. The mentor first checks which chapters are covered at school, then makes a catch-up plan so the student settles in quickly.

Do skill courses give a certificate?

Yes — Web Development, SEO & Digital Marketing and Spoken English courses include a completion certificate and a final project.

Are fees payable in instalments?

Monthly fees are already split month by month. For skill courses, the fee can be paid in two instalments — ask the office for details.
